sections.title: Listening
sections.instruction: 재생 버튼을 누르면 1번부터 순서대로 나와요. 한 번만 들려주니 잘 듣고 답하세요.

questions.q: 다음을 듣고, 여자가 런던에 갔을 때 경험한 날씨로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
대화를 듣고, 남자가 선택할 벽지로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
대화를 듣고, 여자의 심정으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
대화를 듣고, 여자가 어제 한 일로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
대화를 듣고, 두 사람이 대화하는 장소로 가장 적절한 곳을 고르시오.
대화를 듣고, 남자의 마지막 말의 의도로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
대화를 듣고, 여자가 가져올 물건으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
대화를 듣고, 두 사람이 대화 직후에 할 일로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
대화를 듣고, 두 사람이 만화책에 대해 언급하지 <u>않은</u> 것을 고르시오.
다음을 듣고, 남자가 하는 말의 내용으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

groups.part: Choose the right word to complete each sentence. (16~20)

questions.q: Students need to ( ______ ) when they study for an important test.
She was born in Canada, so she is a Canadian ( ______ ).
Scientists can ( ______ ) what the weather will be like tomorrow.
I always feel ( ______ ) before speaking in front of many people.
It was ( ______ ) that he was hungry because he kept looking at the food.
Where can you go to buy plant food?
You can buy both flowers and ______.
Where is the flower sale?
When is the flower sale?
What was Erika's favorite part of the aquarium?
Why does Erika write to Jess?

choices.B: To tell Jess about a family trip
choices.C: To invite Jess to the beach

groups.passage:
To: Jess
From: Erika
Subject: Aquarium Trip

I had a really great time at the aquarium this weekend with my mom and dad. We saw a lot of big fish, and I even got to feed some. I also saw some sharks. They were not too scary. I can show you some funny pictures of them. Do you want to know what I liked most about the trip? I got to see penguins jumping and swimming in the water. I hope you can go to the aquarium with me the next time I go.
From,
Erika

groups.part: Read a story about Amy and Betsy. (27~30)

questions.q: What is the story about?

choices.B: Learning how to play a new game

questions.q: Where did Amy go with her dad?
Why did Amy and Betsy use flashlights?
Why did Betsy smile at the end of the story?

choices.B: Because she knew the cat was outside the tent
choices.C: Because she saw a wild animal

groups.passage:
"I want to go camping like you and Dad did a few weeks ago," Betsy said to her older sister, Amy. "I will like it." "I am not so sure, Betsy," Amy explained. "You need to be older, and you have to be brave in the forest. I think that the wild animals will scare you."
This made Betsy angry. If her sister could do it, she could, too! She wanted to show Amy that she was brave.
"Amy, we can ask mom if we can camp out tonight in the yard behind our house. I can show you that I can stay out there the whole night and not be scared."
"That is a good idea, Betsy. And when you get scared, I will be there to take care of you!" Amy said. Betsy wanted to show that Amy was wrong.
That night, Betsy and Amy were in a tent behind their house. They used two small flashlights to read books to each other. Amy tried to scare her sister, but Betsy was not scared.
Suddenly, Betsy saw a dark shadow covering the side of the tent. She smiled because she knew that the shadow belonged to their cat, Max. Betsy turned to Amy, and Amy's eyes were wide open. Amy shouted, "Wild animal! Wild animal!" Max burst into their tent, happy to see the children.
Betsy was happy, too. She showed that she was not afraid to go camping.

groups.part: A letter in a school newspaper (31~35)

questions.q: Why is the author a student at Wilson Middle School?

choices.B: Because his father is a teacher there
choices.C: Because it is the best school in the area
choices.D: Because he just completed primary school

questions.q: The word <u>perspective</u> is closest in meaning to ______.
The word <u>one</u> refers to ______.
Why does the author like the food at Wilson Middle School?
What does the author imply about the students at his previous school compared to students at Wilson Middle School?

choices.A: They did better in their studies.

groups.passage:
This is my first year attending Wilson Middle School. Last year I went to a different middle school. Over the summer my father got a new job, so our whole family moved. Now I go to Wilson.
I want to make some comments based on my unique <u>perspective</u> as someone who has attended two different middle schools. For example, I was surprised by all the complaints that the students at Wilson make about the food in the cafeteria. Either they don't like it, or they want more choices. But I like the food. The dishes are pretty tasty. And as for choices, at the school I went to last year there were never more than two lunch options each day. Sometimes there was only <u>one</u>!
However, I don't want anyone to think that I have a negative opinion of the Wilson students. Actually, I have been impressed with how involved the students here are. I plan to participate in some of the special clubs here that are organized by students, like the photography club and the hiking club. At my last school, students were not as actively involved in forming clubs.

groups.part: Part 4 · 다음 밑줄 친 단어의 품사를 쓰세요. (36~40)
groups.note: 예: 명사, 대명사, 동사, 형용사, 부사

questions.q: <u>They</u> visited the museum yesterday.
Emma <u>finished</u> her homework.
Kevin plays soccer <u>every</u> weekend.
This is a very <u>beautiful</u> picture.
My brother runs <u>quickly</u> in the park.
다음 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 <u>않은</u> 것을 고르시오.
Sarah ______ breakfast this morning.

다음 밑줄 친 곳을 바르게 고치시오.
There are three <u>mans</u> in the room.

다음 질문에 대한 알맞은 대답을 고르시오.
A: Are Tom and Jack brothers?
B: ______

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르시오.
• An elephant is ______ than a horse.
• The elephant is the ______ animal in the zoo.

다음 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
A: What did Mike buy yesterday?
B: He ______ a new backpack.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르시오.
• This is ______ book I have ever read.
• My sister runs ______ than I do.
다음 문장 중 어색한 것을 고르시오.

choices.①: She enjoys reading books in her free time.
choices.②: My father watches TV every evening.
choices.③: They didn't went to school yesterday.
choices.④: He is studying English right now.
choices.⑤: We have breakfast at seven every morning.

questions.q:
다음 문장을 의문문으로 바르게 바꾼 것을 고르시오.
Emily finished her homework.

빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 것을 고르시오.
______ late for school again, or you will miss the first class.

groups.note: 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 조각을 순서대로 눌러 문장을 만드세요.

questions.prompt: 나는 충분한 수면을 취하는 것이 건강을 유지하는 데 중요하다고 생각합니다.
questions.answer: I think that getting enough sleep is important to stay healthy.

questions.prompt: 이것은 내가 작년에 방문했던 장소 중 가장 아름다운 곳입니다.
questions.answer: This is the most beautiful place that I visited last year.

questions.prompt: 그녀는 친구들과 영화를 보러 가기에는 너무 바빴습니다.
answer: She was too busy to go to the movies with her friends.
She was too busy to go with her friends to the movies.

questions.prompt: 나는 그에게 이 문제를 어떻게 해결해야 하는지 설명해 달라고 부탁했습니다.
questions.answer: I asked him to explain how to solve this problem.

questions.prompt: 이 수학 문제는 내가 혼자 풀기에는 너무 어렵습니다.
questions.answer: This math problem is too difficult for me to solve by myself.
